arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Polidoro argued the ordinance restricts speech on private property.
Mr. Gormley noted the ordinance differs from prior statutes in scope.
Mr. Cantor argued the village exercises police power to protect privacy.
Mr. Polidoro addressed Justice O'Connor's question about trick-or-treaters.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the limits of local control over door-to-door speech. It balances community safety against individual expression rights. The outcome shapes how villages regulate solicitation on private land.
